title: Find the hidden file
story: Programs often keep their settings in hidden files, whose names start with a dot. Plain ls doesn't show them. There's one in your home folder for your design tools.

files.~/.{{hidden}}:
# settings for design tools
num_seqs = 8
sampling_temp = 0.1

tasks.text: List everything in your home folder, hidden files included
Report the design settings file's name

hints: `ls` has an option that shows all files, including the hidden ones.
`ls -a` shows everything. Look for a name that isn't `.bashrc`, `.` or `..`.
Type `ls -a`, then type .{{hidden}} in the answer box.
